title: Presentation of a modified method of vestibuloplasty with an early prosthetic loading
authors: Konstantinova D, Djongova E, Arnautska H, Georgiev T, Peev S, Dimova M. J of IMAB. 2015 Oct-Dec. 21(4):964-968. doi: 10.5272/jimab.2015214.964
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The method proposed by the authors using xenoderm grafts and early loading on the newly-formed vestibule has proved a success and implies further in-depth application with larger group of patients” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
